from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and its citation relationships with OTHER papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    cites_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper cites/references in its bibliography")
    cited_by_other_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper in their bibliographies")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
